# Lucide icon subset

Source: lucide-static 1.71.0 (https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide).

Local SVG symbols, unchanged paths; presentation attributes are inherited from `.icon`.
Icons: folder-git-2, search, shield-check, activity, settings, command, user-round, x, file-text, chart-no-axes-combined, circle-help, arrow-up-right, git-branch, menu. License: ISC / MIT, see LICENSE. No runtime dependency.

Additional symbols: arrow-down-left, arrow-up-right, scan, git-fork, log-in, workflow, circle-off, flask-conical, chevron-down, sparkles, sun, moon, monitor.
